name: Sudan
value: Famine risk spreads to South Darfur
summary: FEWS NET says Famine risk has spread to South Darfur and persists in North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling
state: FEWS NET's September 2026 to January 2027 update says the risk of Famine has spread to parts of South Darfur, including Sharg Aj-Jabal, where acute malnutrition in two of four camps assessed exceeded the Famine threshold, and persists in parts of North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling in South Kordofan. WFP said on 22 Oct that funding shortfalls forced it to cut monthly food aid to about 900,000 displaced people, and puts acute hunger at about 19.5 million people (Al Jazeera, 2 Nov). Famine risk spreading to new areas keeps the Alert.
for_you: Displaced people in Darfur and Kordofan face the greatest risk of starvation; aid cuts widen the gap. Travellers should follow FCDO advice, which warns against all travel to Sudan. Regional knock-on effects include refugee flows into Chad, Egypt and South Sudan.
rubric_hit: Famine spreading to new areas: FEWS NET risk of Famine extended to South Darfur (Alert criterion)
